title: Quota pools
text: Candidates read only the pools their model consumes. Readable zero blocks; unreadable or missing quota is unknown. Claude has a separate 5-hour cap. Cursor has exactly two monthly pools, ordered universe-wide; pool preference affects consumption, never level membership.
evidence: Two Cursor rows proved by QA run 45473 / artifact 32323; current order reread through universe.cursor_quota_order.get, 2026-10-13. Other quota semantics observed in the routing guide.
